name: adapter_info
description: Report the MCP adapter's configuration (service URL, key presence, version) and the service's health status. Use first to verify the wiring.

name: browser_capabilities
description: Report whether interactive browser sessions are enabled on the service and their limits (max sessions/tabs, TTL, evaluate support).

name: browser_click
description: Click an element in a tab, identified by its accessibility ``ref`` (e.g. ``@e2`` from a snapshot) or a CSS ``selector``. One of the two is required.

tab_id.description: Tab id from the session/tab responses.

ref.description: Accessibility ref from the page snapshot, e.g. ``@e2``.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element(s) to extract from the fetched page.

name: browser_close_session
description: Close a browser session and all of its tabs. Always call this when the user is done browsing to free the session slot.

name: browser_close_tab
description: Close one tab of a browser session.

tab_id.description: Tab id from the session/tab responses.

name: browser_create_session
description: Create an interactive browser session. Returns the ``session_id`` and a ``tabs`` list. Pass ``url`` to also open the first tab (its ``tab_id`` is returned). Keep both ids: the other browser tools require them. Close the session with browser_close_session when done.

name: browser_evaluate
description: Evaluate a JavaScript *expression* in a tab and return its value (requires the service to allow evaluate mode). The expression must be a single expression returning a JSON-serializable value, e.g. ``document.title`` or ``JSON.stringify([...].map(...))``.

tab_id.description: Tab id from the session/tab responses.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page.

name: browser_navigate
description: Navigate a tab to a URL (or open a new tab with ``new_tab: true``) and return the new page state: url, title, and an accessibility snapshot with element refs (``@eN``) you can pass to browser_click / browser_type.

tab_id.description: Tab id from the session/tab responses.

new_tab.description: Open the URL in a new tab (the service creates the tab).

wait_selector.description: Browser mode only: CSS selector to wait for before extraction.

name: browser_type
description: Type text into a form field (by ``ref`` or CSS ``selector``, or the active element when neither is given). ``clear`` empties the field first; ``key`` presses a key afterwards (e.g. submit with ``Enter``).

tab_id.description: Tab id from the session/tab responses.

ref.description: Accessibility ref from the page snapshot, e.g. ``@e2``.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element(s) to extract from the fetched page.

name: cache_cleanup
description: Run a cache maintenance pass (delete expired entries, enforce size/entry caps, optional VACUUM) and report exactly what was deleted.

max_entries.description: Shrink the cache to at most this many entries.

max_size_mb.description: Shrink the cache to at most this many megabytes.

name: cache_delete
description: Remove one exact URL from the scrape cache.

name: cache_purge
description: Delete all cached scrape entries, optionally scoped to one ``domain``. Destructive: use only when the user asks to clear the cache.

domain.description: Domain whose cache entries should be purged.

name: cache_stats
description: Report cache size, entry counts and expiry breakdowns for the scrape, search and transcript result caches.

name: cache_vacuum
description: Run SQLite VACUUM to reclaim disk space (I/O intensive; maintenance windows on low-power hosts preferred).

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch one URL and return its content (markdown or JSON) plus metadata. Supports cached http mode and headless-browser mode, optional CSS-scoped extraction, and link extraction with follow depth.

mode.description: Fetch strategy: auto (default), http, or browser.

wait_selector.description: Browser mode only: CSS selector to wait for before extraction.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch fresh content.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Per-request cache TTL. Overrides the domain/global defaults.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element(s) to extract from the fetched page.

include_external.description: Include links outside the page origin.

include_content.description: Include the scraped content of each linked URL.

name: fetch_url_batch
description: Fetch up to 50 URLs in parallel (service caps concurrency). Each item: {url, mode?, timeout_seconds?, force_refresh?}. Results are per-URL; one failure does not fail the batch.

mode.description: Fetch strategy: auto (default), http, or browser.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch fresh content.

urls.description: Up to 50 URLs to fetch. Each item: {url, mode?, timeout_seconds?, force_refresh?}.

name: get_youtube_transcript
description: Get a YouTube video transcript (timestamped segments + full text). The video is identified by a bare 11-character ID or any YouTube URL. Caption tracks are chosen by preference: ``languages`` is the priority order (alias of ``lang``). Use ``format`` to return plain text (default) or segments list; ``max_chars`` controls output size.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID (11 characters) or a full YouTube URL.

languages.description: Preferred caption languages in priority order (alias of ``lang``).

force_refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch fresh content.

format.description: Output format: ``text`` returns the full transcript as plain text with metadata; ``segments`` returns a list of start/duration/text objects.

max_chars.description: Maximum output characters (default from client configuration). Set to truncate with explicit marker.

name: search
description: Search the web (or social/videos/news verticals) via the service's search providers. Returns ranked results with title, url, snippet, vertical and rank. No search is run for an empty query.

safe_search.description: Safe-search level: off, moderate (default) or strict.

time_range.description: Restrict results to this time range.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch fresh content.

name: search_capabilities
description: List the service's search providers and their capabilities (verticals, filters, time ranges, sources). Read-only discovery; no search is performed.
